title: Spicy Thai Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired stir-fry made with the freshest ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced Slovakian sausage and cook until browned, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the sliced Monsoon peppers and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the diced Aerated tomatoes, stir-fry sauce, and cooked sausage mixture to the skillet.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil leaves and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the spicy stir-fry hot, garnished with additional Thai basil leaves if desired.
Garnish with a dollop of yogurt to cool down the heat.
